meta.title: About Puntr | A Community-First Platform for South African sport
meta.description: Puntr is a Community-First Platform where South African sports fans post picks, lock them at kick-off and build a public record. AI-Powered Insights are coming.

hero.body: Puntr is a <1>Community-First Platform</1> where South African sports fans post their picks, lock them at kick-off and build a public record they can be proud of. <1>AI-Powered Insights</1> are on the way.

why.p1: Everyone has an opinion on the game. Puntr gives those opinions a fair place to be tested: every pick is timestamped, locked and graded the same way for everyone.
why.p2: Tips on social media vanish when they go wrong. Puntr keeps every pick, win or lose, so you can see who is genuinely good.
